items.title: Nilpotent elements behave as expected under henselization and strict henselization
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the nilradical of the henselization and of the strict henselization with the extension of the nilradical of the local ring. The proof uses the universal property of the nilradical as the largest ideal of nilpotent elements with reduced quotient: the extended nilradical consists of nilpotent elements, and the quotient of the henselization by it is the henselization of the reduced quotient ring, hence reduced. The two facts together force the equality. The strict henselization case is handled by the analogous quotient result.
